These are read-only input copies; never modify them, profiles or launch settings. The repository under work is <WORKTREE>: your current directory is NOT the repository, so every repository read or write MUST use absolute paths under it. Only Dev may modify repository files. Do not commit, integrate, push, close tasks or invoke other agents. Produce evidence in your final response, not files.
TASK:
implement fixture

Return a concise final summary of your plan or implementation and any limitations.
